import.title: Import Backport commits
import.description: Upload a CSV from the machine running the browser, or paste CSV/TSV. Each row must contain a commit ID and a title; commit_id and commit_title are recommended, and commit hash, commit, hash, sha as well as title, subject and patch title are also accepted. Confirming replaces the current commit list.
import.localFileHint: A local browser file, up to 1 MiB.
import.fixIssues: Fix or remove all invalid rows before confirming:

issue.shaInvalid: commit_id must be a hexadecimal Git SHA of at least 7 characters
issue.titleSingleLine: commit_title must be a single line of text
issue.titleMismatch: The commit_title for the same commit_id must be identical
issue.tooMany: The number of commits cannot exceed 5,000

error.parseText: Failed to parse the pasted commit text
error.csvOnly: Only .csv files are supported; use paste import for TSV.

setup.subtitle: Observability capabilities are aggregated and provided by witty-service
setup.unavailableDescription: The frontend has not yet obtained usable Insight capabilities from witty-service. Please make sure witty-service has the Insight integration enabled and can reach witty-insight. Once connectivity is restored, return to this page to automatically load the overview, traces, interruptions and health data.
setup.paragraph1: These observability capabilities are aggregated and exposed through witty-service to observe how AI Agents run, helping you locate conversation traces, model load and runtime anomalies.
setup.paragraph2: The frontend never connects directly to raw witty-insight. If it is unavailable here, please first check the integration path between witty-service and witty-insight.
setup.step1: Make sure witty-service has the Insight integration enabled
setup.step2: Make sure witty-service can access the witty-insight service
setup.step3: Refresh this page; the system will automatically detect and load monitoring data through witty-service
